description: ROT-1 (16, D86): two mesocycle starts on the challenge block (block 2 and block 3, week 1). Start 1: two compound legs anchors from SEL-1; of six accessories a stalled leg curl and a disliked lunge rotate (the one-third cap), a liked and a progressing one stay. Start 2: the anchors are kept (the leg press stalled once, counted), the replacement with rising reps at the same load scores +1, a stalled calf raise rotates.

exercises.evidence_note: 45-degree back extension performed with spinal flexion/extension: erectors prime mover (expert-opinion). Bodyweight with an optional held plate (D65): f_bw 0.6, the upper body above the hips is about 0.68 of bodyweight (segment tables) and the 45-degree bench shortens its lever (expert-opinion, weak).
Kubo 2019 (moderate): squat-pattern adductor and glute credit; 0.75 only for the deep barbell squat.
